title: Seeking whilst paused retains paused state (avc-50fps-cbr-hd)
product-requirement: Client must maintain pausing state after seeking.
specification: Terminals MUST implement Media Source Extensions API (https://www.w3.org/TR/media-source-2/).
assertion: MediaSource and MediaElement events must emit in expected order, and properties must be of expected values.

changelog.summary: Fixed race condition: slow segment download speed can cause timeouts
